<parameter=content>
In economics, the invisible hand theory, introduced by Adam Smith, suggests that the self-regulating nature of the marketplace can lead to economic prosperity without the need for heavy government intervention. This theory is foundational to classical economics and free market ideology.
</parameter>
<parameter=related_knowledge>
Adam Smith, The Wealth of Nations, laissez-faire, supply and demand, market equilibrium, free trade, capitalism
</parameter>
